name: md2hd
description: Markdown, mapped — point md2hd at a file or folder of notes and read the map in your browser. Frontmatter becomes nodes, wikilinks become edges.

scripts.build: npm --prefix ../dev run build && rm -rf dist skills && cp -R ../dev/dist dist && mkdir -p skills && cp -R ../dev/skills/writing-md2hd-maps skills/writing-md2hd-maps
